_readme: Third-party binaries the add-ons ship (addons.json "files"), kept out of git: `make` (scripts/fetch_blobs.py) downloads each to its path and checks its sha256, failing the build on a mismatch. A new file or version: upload it to rts /var/www/rts-site/elite/blobs/<sha256>/<name> (never change a published one), add an entry here and its path to .gitignore.

blobs.what: DXVK 2.7.1 x32 d3d9.dll (official release, renamed; zlib licence, dxvk/DXVK_LICENSE.txt)
FMOD Ex 4.32.20 fmodex.dll (Firelight Technologies; the file Elite ships as Elite_bin/Elite_fmodex.bin)
FMOD Ex 4.32.3 fmodex.dll (Firelight Technologies; Relic's file from the game's Steam depot)
